purpose: Add a versioned fail-closed checkpoint boundary for the Python BDQ trainer that saves one clean-boundary state and restores it in a fresh CPU Python process without Unity, reproducing the same next replay sample and the same bounded next optimizer result as an uninterrupted deterministic reference.

saved_state: optimizer update and target synchronization counters
replay contents, ring cursor, accounting metrics, and sampling RNG state
package, runtime, settings, seeds, and contract identity
checkpoint_boundary.state_integrity: SHA-256 over the canonical encoded state subtree
rejections: schema-version, contract, package, runtime, settings, or seed drift
checkpoint_boundary.failure_mode: reject before any restored object is returned

reference_workload.class: synthetic deterministic transitions driven through the production collector and scheduled selector
reference_workload.observation_frames: constant float32 (i mod 20)/20 frame per stack slot
reference_workload.next_observation_frames: constant float32 ((i + 1) mod 20)/20 frame per stack slot
reference_workload.action_masks: every action available on both branches
reference_workload.actions: scheduled epsilon-greedy selection at completed-transition count i

exclusions: a Unity rollout, live LLAPI collection, or any new environment interaction
optimizer update 6 on the R3O trajectory
an action selected with update-5 weights
